source: Restaurants and bars chosen from OpenTable listings (ratings, open status and coordinates from each OpenTable page, including its Restaurants near Aronoff Center list); attractions and venue coordinates from Wikipedia, with Smale Riverfront Park from aroundus.com and Findlay Market hours from findlaymarket.org (Nov 2026)

spots.name: Taste of Belgium at The Banks
Fountain Square
spots.blurb: Downtown's central plaza around the 1871 Tyler Davidson Fountain, with a seasonal ice rink and holiday tree.
spots.blurbEs: La plaza central del centro, alrededor de la fuente Tyler Davidson de 1871, con pista de hielo de temporada y árbol navideño.

spots.name: Smale Riverfront Park
spots.blurb: A riverfront park between the stadiums with gardens, fountains, play areas and Carol Ann's Carousel.
spots.blurbEs: Un parque junto al río entre los estadios, con jardines, fuentes, zonas de juego y el carrusel Carol Ann's Carousel.

spots.name: Findlay Market
spots.blurb: Ohio's oldest continuously operated public market, with produce, meats, bakeries and food stalls; open regular hours Friday through Sunday of Thanksgiving weekend.
spots.blurbEs: El mercado público de funcionamiento continuo más antiguo de Ohio, con frutas y verduras, carnes, panaderías y puestos de comida; abre en horario normal de viernes a domingo del fin de semana de Acción de Gracias.

spots.name: Cincinnati Art Museum
spots.blurb: A large encyclopedic art museum in Eden Park with free general admission.
spots.blurbEs: Un gran museo de arte enciclopédico en Eden Park con entrada general gratuita.
